recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If MnM wants a more explicit formula for particular infusion representations, that should be a new clarification rather than a FHIR-7914 fixup.
issue_request: FHIR-7914 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 datatypes and asked to clarify the Timing.repeat.duration note that IV infusion duration may be part of the event definition; the resolution was to express that infusion duration is inferred from specified quantity and rate.
initial_application: Jira comments identify svn revision 6036. The git-svn commit a2677428ec3e34f6d9095bcf7e8566ede5a3e9e0, '#7914 - clarify definition about Timing duration', added the parenthetical 'where the duration is implicit in the specified quantity and rate' to source/datatypes/timing.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini routes datatypes through the active datatype page machinery and marks Timing normative, confirming build scope. Current source still contains the clarification for Timing.repeat.duration and the corresponding durationMax guidance. Later formatting/refactoring history preserved the wording, and targeted Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current normative Timing source already clarifies the IV infusion example by explaining that duration is implicit in the specified quantity and rate.
